description: Set the base resume every application is tailored from, from exactly one source. A new upload uses AI tokens; a saved document does not. A local file path is not a URL. Pass the resume unchanged. In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file. It replaces the user's current base resume (the old one stays in their documents), so call it only when the user wants this resume used.

document_id.description: One of the user's saved resumes to make the base (an id from getmattered_get_account). Free. Pass this OR resume_text OR resume_url.

resume_file.description: Only for a resume file the user attached in ChatGPT: pass the attached file here, not retyped text. In any other client pass resume_text or resume_url. It is downloaded once, right away: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: The user's resume text exactly as they gave it, word for word. Never change dates, employers, titles or any fact. Pass this OR resume_url OR document_id.

resume_url.description: An https link to the resume file: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB. Pass this OR resume_text OR document_id.

name: getmattered_set_resume

documentId.description: The resume now used as the base for every application.

onboardingCompleted.description: True when the account setup is finished, so GetMattered searches for this user.

parsed.description: False when the resume is still being read; call getmattered_get_account in a minute.

preferencesSeeded.description: True when empty job preferences were filled from this resume.

title: Set Resume
